seed_search: 0..511; pre-model target, vendor, and density balance only
task: Suspicious Calcification heatmap localization in a bbox-selected abnormal cohort
controls: other annotated findings; not normal mammograms

reference.external_cbis_ddsm: ROI-mask DICOM converted to bounding boxes for evaluation only

partitions.validation: architecture, early stopping, and checkpoint selection only
partitions.calibration: current-method heatmap and presence threshold selection after model freeze
partitions.locked_test_artifact_label: historically inspected internal retrospective partition; not confirmatory
partitions.external_cbis_ddsm: external retrospective CBIS-DDSM Calc-Test domain-shift evaluation
partitions.confirmatory_locked_test: not available in the current evidence package

threshold_policy.current_methods: heatmap and presence thresholds selected on calibration only
threshold_policy.grad_cam_score_cam_unet: thresholds inherited from frozen source artifacts; the original selection partition cannot be reconstructed
threshold_policy.inference_scope: all comparisons involving inherited baseline thresholds are retrospective conditional evidence

annotation_provenance.policy: exact local snapshot frozen by explicit user instruction; mismatch disclosed

decoder_scope.interpretation: a declared model-capacity limitation; no reference boxes are removed from evaluation

claim_boundary: No confirmatory, patient-independent, clinical, state-of-the-art, or universal-superiority claim is permitted.
